scope: Pre-H read-only results audit. H execution, generation and repository code were not modified.
sourcePathConvention: sources entries are relative to evidenceRoot unless absolute. Visual assessments are root/material_trials human-style image inspection reports, not ground-truth metrics.

common.controlMechanism: H3 VLM plus VAE image references; not ControlNet

A.geometry: Pixal3D through TRELLIS2 nodes/VAEs, fixed existing coarse mesh; not a fresh pure TRELLIS.2 run

time.scope: Sum of recorded face-request runtimes; excludes Hi3D, baking, inspection and intervening waits; not a throughput benchmark.

A.visualReview: Raw -X is nearly white statue; -Z turns the head away from its rear-view guide. +Z has clearer facial features but a white footwear artifact. Acceptance is silhouette-only.

normalTextureControl.limit: Normal map changes also affect incidence-based view weighting; not pure lighting isolation.

time.scope: Sum of recorded face-request runtimes; excludes Hi3D, baking, inspection and intervening waits; not a throughput benchmark.

B.visualReview: Full-1M clay has more distinct eyes, lips, nose and hair than A. B raw +Z has detailed face and black heels; -X still has mostly white hair/clothes/limbs/shoes. Final Box still has facial bands and mixed-view artifacts.

B_normal.method: Add robust area-weighted geometry NORMAL to identical positions/indices/materials, then native rebake and exact B RGB reuse.
B_normal.visualReview: Normal-only control did not solve facial bands/double contours.

C.depthSource: Same six B RGB views; full registered/calibrated MoGe depth, not a high-frequency-only residual
limitations: Depth-to-orthographic registration is an anchored affine approximation.
Current occlusion uses vertex splats; final native rebake supplies exact rasterized depth.
C.visualReview: Rejected as final result: facial/neck/limb geometry and appearance worsened despite depth-objective fitting.

C2.depthSource: Same six B RGB views; full registered/calibrated MoGe depth, not a high-frequency-only residual
limitations: Depth-to-orthographic registration is an anchored affine approximation.
Current occlusion uses vertex splats; final native rebake supplies exact rasterized depth.
C2.visualReview: Rejected as final result: face/hair/neck/limb quality does not surpass B; C2 repairs the head-top boundary artifact only.

D.visualReview: Raw whitening remains outside face/hands; this removes structural VAE latents only.

F.visualReview: Raw -X restores blond hair, gray dress, skin-toned legs and black shoes. Actual Box FRONT/LEFT/ISO has less white hair/clothing leakage; FRONT/LEFT eye sockets, below-nose and mouth bands/double contours remain. RIGHT largely unchanged. Not a whole-face or six-view solution.

E.render: Lit native PBR Box; not unlit and not direct mesh clay
E.visualReview: Strong facial bands/grooves remain with all six-view RGB made uniform. RGB color disagreements are therefore insufficient to explain all artifacts; this does not uniquely identify geometry rather than normals, lighting or view weighting.

color.scope: Correct texture RGB EOTF before interpolation and export linear FLOAT32 COLOR_0; native guide/baseline control only, not a freshly regenerated six-view H3 result.
color.causalLimit: Verified systematic B guide brightening bug, distinct from the white-statue H3 output also seen in A.

C_depthTiming.note: Depth predictions first generated during C initial run, then reused for corrected C v2 and C2. Do not count these as three fresh neural depth runs.

auditCautions: Do not label A as a fresh native TRELLIS.2 run; it uses fixed Pixal3D geometry through TRELLIS2 infrastructure.
All six accepted means silhouette QA only; raw color, view direction, identity and detail can still be wrong.
The discarded grainy B clay used the official converter default250k face sampling; the final comparison preserves all1000000 triangles. Do not attribute that display failure to Hi3D.

A/B use the same photo and H3 parameters but different geometry-derived guides and bake bounds. Native tile aspect is non-isotropic; H3 uses physical-aspect canvas and maps it back. Do not diagnose an uncorrected square-tile screenshot as actual world distortion.
B-normal final asset is cda76..., not its intermediate69d8... geometry asset. C2-preparation false run flags describe preparation; use final C2-run results.
Normal controls affect both lighting and incidence-based cross-view weights, not lighting alone.
C/C2 full-depth targets are learned estimates with anchored affine registration and vertex-splat occlusion, not ground-truth absolute geometry.
C2 corrects a verified boundary plane concentration. It does not establish improved overall face accuracy.

F changes only one generated view and also removes prompt instructions corresponding to omitted VLM pictures. Its success cannot isolate image removal from those prompt edits, and is not an all-six-view solution.
E keeps lighting, normals, alpha, geometry and blending active; persistent grooves with uniform RGB do not uniquely prove one remaining mechanism.
The production color fix and F conditioning test are separate; F keeps the original pale B guide unchanged.
New A/B and later controls do not by themselves identify every cause of the user original attachment. That attribution requires matching original pipeline/source provenance.
More triangles and plausible AI details are not a quantitative proof of fidelity to the real person; no measured ground-truth mesh is available.
